intro: Serena's Head is the grisly trophy taken from the matriarch of the Dry Hills harpies in the northern Barrens. Darsok Swiftdagger of the Crossroads demanded it as proof of her demise, intending to display it upon Horde supply wagons as a harsh deterrent against further aerial raids.

p: The Witchwing harpies of the Dry Hills have long plagued trade moving through the northern Barrens, but under Serena Bloodfeather their assaults turned particularly vicious. Her raids against Horde supply lines were driven by personal vengeance for her sister, who fell to the beastmaster Rexxar. To permanently break the morale of the flock, the orc rogue Darsok Swiftdagger ordered Serena hunted down. Rather than letting her death go unnoticed, he sought her severed head so it could be mounted upon the next outbound caravan—serving as a stark, bloody warning to any harpy watching from the crags above.
